claimChecks.claim: Senro tests WebMCP tools using goal-oriented and trajectory evaluations across language models.
claimChecks.evidenceQuote: test WebMCP tools using goal-oriented evals, trajectory evals, and more across LLMs

claimChecks.claim: Senro monitors how agent tools are used in production.
claimChecks.evidenceQuote: monitors how AI agents use them in production

claimChecks.claim: The cited maker description says the free plan allows up to 25K events per month and 250 evaluations per month using the user's own API key.
claimChecks.evidenceQuote: monitor up to 25K events/mo and run up to 250 evals/mo using your own API key

claimChecks.claim: CircleIt lets a user mark up a web page in Chrome and send the feedback to a running Claude Code or Codex session.
claimChecks.evidenceQuote: Mark up any web page in Chrome and press Send. Your running Claude Code or Codex session wakes up

claimChecks.claim: CircleIt can keep feedback pending when no agent is running and pick it up when a session starts in that project.
claimChecks.evidenceQuote: If nothing is running, feedback stays pending until the next session starts in that project.

claimChecks.claim: CircleIt supports requiring approval before selected feedback is sent to a developer.
claimChecks.evidenceQuote: Set a person or a site to Needs approval. Their feedback waits until the owner or an approver approves it.

claimChecks.claim: Velu's checker scores documentation against the Agent-Friendly Documentation Spec using the afdocs reference implementation.
The checker assesses Markdown availability, including Markdown URLs and server support for an Accept header.
claimChecks.evidenceQuote: Markdown at .md URLs, and a server that honours Accept: text/markdown.

claimChecks.claim: The described checks include server-rendered content, page size limits, and soft 404 detection.
claimChecks.evidenceQuote: Server-rendered content, 50K character budgets, and where your content starts.
